item.title: 基于良性事实的强化学习会放大记忆化私有数据的泄露
item.summary: arXiv:2608.21727v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is deployed to make models better at reasoning tasks, but its side effect on what models will divulge is under studied. Here we show that RLVR on facts increases extraction of personally identifiable information (PII)
